name: MotionBricks Range
description: A third-person shooter prototype whose operator is animated live, in the browser, by NVIDIA MotionBricks (SOMA model via onnxruntime-web), with a holographic preview of the generated motion, a Tripo-generated special forces operator with a bullpup rifle and rocket launcher, an Unreal-style grey-box level, and destructible physics props.
